page.overview:
Who is Hélio Castroneves?

Hélio Alves de Castro Neves is a Brazilian driver. He was briefly a test driver for in 2002, but has spent the majority of his career racing in the United States. He is a four-time winner of the Indianapolis 500 (2001, 2002, 2009, 2021) along with 26 other wins in Indy car racing. He has also driven in the V8 Supercar series in Australia, and in Stock Car Brazil.

He currently drives in the IMSA sports car series, along with a parttime Indy car schedule.
